fix-diff.txt:
--- scripts/media/fixtures/broken-pr-review.nika.yaml	2026-07-02 18:59:10
+++ scripts/media/fixtures/fixed-pr-review.nika.yaml	2026-07-02 18:59:38
@@ -1,7 +1,6 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
-# media fixture · deliberately BROKEN — the static-check-fix demo "before".
-# Two real defects: a task reads another task's output without depending on
-# it, and a typo'd task reference in the `when:` gate.
+# media fixture · the static-check-fix demo "after" — same workflow, fixed:
+# declared dependencies, fixed typo, cost ceiling, strict schema, permits.
 nika: v1
 workflow: pr-risk-review
 model: ollama/llama3.1
@@ -13,20 +12,30 @@
       capture: structured
 
   - id: assess
+    depends_on: [diff]
     infer:
       prompt: |
         Risk-assess this diff. Be terse.
         ${{ tasks.diff.output.stdout }}
+      max_tokens: 400
       schema:
         type: object
         required: [risk]
+        additionalProperties: false
         properties:
           risk: { type: string, enum: [low, medium, high] }
 
   - id: comment
-    when: "${{ tasks.asses.output.risk == 'high' }}"
+    depends_on: [assess]
+    when: "${{ tasks.assess.output.risk == 'high' }}"
     invoke:
       tool: "nika:write"
       args:
         path: "review.md"
         content: "${{ tasks.assess.output }}"
+
+permits:
+  fs:
+    write: ["review.md"]
+  exec: ["git"]
+  tools: ["nika:write"]
